title: Simple email/password login endpoint proxying to Supabase Auth
cancellation_note: Implemented, then rolled back at the user's request on 2026-09-13: it contradicted 03-backend-folder-architecture.md §1 ('auth issuance, JWT minting, password flows' are explicitly NOT owned by the gateway). Deviation was flagged in analyze.json.open_questions rather than asked about up front, which the user identified as the wrong call for a contract contradiction (vs. an open question). See agent-history/003-task-backend-auth-authorization for the correct §5.6-scoped replacement. Folder kept per 02-working.md §1 (nothing is ever deleted).

plan_refs.section: §1 What this service owns/does not own; §5.6 internal/auth

goals.description: Add SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to platform/config with local-dev defaults
Add a Supabase Auth client in internal/auth that performs the GoTrue password grant (stdlib net/http, no new dependency)
Add POST /v1/auth/login handler: bind email/password, call the client, map Supabase errors to HTTP status via shared/errs
One runnable test that does not hit live Supabase (httptest stand-in for GoTrue)
